unknown_rule: Unknown or nonpositive ATR disables new promotion and keeps H. Never replace missing ATR by epsilon.
constant_choice: Unit ATR yields parameter-free attenuation beyond the frozen20 lookback. No threshold/window search; potentially very strong damping must be reported.
standing_H1_preservation: Numeric score lower bound H; cross-stock ordinal can still move when others are promoted.
